opus.problem: The cited verse, Mark 4:19, does not mention thorns or seed that 'hears the word'. That part comes from Mark 4:18, so the clue is not fully supported by its reference. Also, both clue 3 and clue 2 come from the parable of the sower, and clue 3 restates the choking idea from clue 2, so the two overlap heavily.
A crown twisted together and set on Jesus' head points straight to the well-known 'crown of thorns', so this one clue gives the word away instead of being medium hard.
